transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Tuesday, October 6. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. SIR row: Will annul EC orders not in keeping with law, says Supreme Court. The Supreme Court has asked the Election Commission to clarify decision-making processes related to voter roll revisions. It emphasized that decisions should be taken unanimously or by majority among commission members only. Senior advocate Vikas Singh argued for preserving records and scrutiny of the commission's actions. The court will examine allegations of unilateral actions against the Chief Election Commissioner. 86 to 101: Kohli's final ODI window to break Tendulkar's century record. Virat Kohli is 15 centuries away from becoming the first batter to reach 101 international hundreds, with ODI cricket now his only route to Sachin Tendulkar's record. India have 11 confirmed bilateral ODIs before the 2027 World Cup, while the Asia Cup offers additional opportunities. A possible six-match South Africa series in the new FTP could give India further preparation before the World Cup, but the century chase remains a difficult one. Before triple murder, Bengaluru techie used AI to 'rehearse' attack scenarios. In a shocking incident in Seegehalli, Bengaluru, techie J Kenneth allegedly murdered his partner's family. He had used artificial intelligence to research various methods of attack prior to the crime. Shwetha, Kenneth's partner, had borrowed substantial loans to support him, causing family tension. Following a confrontation with her parents about the loans, Kenneth reportedly carried out the violent act. Accenture CEO rejects concerns that AI is a threat to the company's business model. Accenture's CEO Julie Sweet shared insights on significant advancements in artificial intelligence impacting the company. Over 400 clients have started advanced AI projects in the past fiscal year. The company recorded fourth-quarter revenue growth fueled by AI-driven efficiencies and client transformation integration. Additionally, productivity enhancements have allowed for executing larger projects without proportional headcount increases. Woman declares rupees 67.4L ancestral jewellery in ITR; gets notice, she wins in ITAT. The assessment threw up two separate issues. The first concerned jewellery worth rupees 67,39,949 that the woman had disclosed in Schedule AL of her income tax return. The tribunal also examined whether the rupees 12 lakh paid to the HUF represented a genuine brokerage expense when the same person, the HUF's Karta/coparcener, had already received another rupees 12 lakh for the same transaction. Houthis target Aramco refinery, Saudi capital airport as Mecca defence pact activated. Yemen's Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for missile and drone attacks targeting Saudi Arabia's infrastructure. The reported strikes included key sites such as airports and an Aramco refinery. In response, Saudi-backed Yemeni forces have intensified their offensive against the Houthis along the Red Sea coast. The conflict has prompted Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Türkiye to activate their defense pact for collective response. Oil prices hover near $100 as Middle East supply holds up, Gulf risks persist. Oil prices are currently around $100 a barrel as stable Middle Eastern exports ease supply concerns. However, ongoing regional conflicts, including Houthi attacks, raise risks of disruptions. Officials indicate that rebuilding global oil stockpiles could take years due to significant withdrawals. Industry executives predict that demand recovery may not occur until 2028 or 2029. Trump blames Iran for flydubai incident, Vance 'defers', says 'nothing conclusively yet'. US President Donald Trump said he personally believed Iran was responsible for the foiled flydubai incident, while ice President JD Vance said he had not seen conclusive evidence linking Tehran to the attack. Trump signs order to ease diesel costs, 'save millions of dollars' for farmers. In response to rising diesel prices, US President Donald Trump has enacted an executive order designed to alleviate financial pressures across multiple sectors. This order is anticipated to substantially cut fuel costs for farmers and truck drivers, ultimately contributing to lower grocery prices. Additionally, it urges states to expand access to tax-free red-dyed diesel and consider lifting specific fuel taxes. China's desert oilfield hits record: 8,080m deep core from 500m-year-old rock. China's Fuman Oilfield in Xinjiang has extracted 26.86 million tons of oil and gas equivalent from ultra-deep formations beneath the Taklimakan Desert. Engineers also recovered rock cores from a record depth of 8,080 metres at the Zhentan-1 well. The rocks are estimated to have remained buried for about 500 million years, according to CNPC and CCTV.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Rahul's Portal Receives Highest Number Of Voices Of Concern From Madhya Pradesh On Education. The NGT has pulled up Bhopal authorities for passing responsibility over alleged encroachments and environmental violations at Shahpura Lake. From Roshanpura To DPI, Teacher Protests Spread Across Bhopal As Traffic Crawls. Bhopal witnessed teacher protests at five locations on Monday as different groups pressed recruitment, TET and other demands. 45,000 Police Posts Vacant In Madhya Pradesh As Manpower Strength Trails Sanctioned Level. Madhya Pradesh is grappling with a police manpower shortage, with officials estimating around 45,000 vacant posts. Tiger Kills 63-Year-Old Cattle Grazer In MP's Seoni, rupees 8 Lakh Compensation Sanctioned. A tiger killed 63-year-old cattle grazer Summar Lal near Pindrai beat in MP's Seoni on Monday morning. PM MITRA Park, Gwalior Telecom Zone To Headline MP's GIS 2027 Investment Pitch. Madhya Pradesh is reshaping its investment pitch for GIS 2027 in Bhopal, with infrastructure, textiles, telecom and manufacturing set to take centre stage. Bhopal Metro Turns To Station Branding As Ticket Revenue Stays Below rupees 500 Per Day. Bhopal Metro has offered semi-naming and co-branding rights for eight stations, including MP Nagar and Rani Kamlapati, as it looks to strengthen non-fare revenue while average daily ticket earnings remain below rupees 500. CM Youth Conclave-2026 will be held in MP's Bhopal on October 6. Indore's Cleanliness Crown Faces Strike Test As Sanitation Workers Warn Of Full Shutdown. Indore's sanitation system faces disruption as workers began a five-day strike on Monday, threatening a complete shutdown from Tuesday. Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Says Ladli Behna Scheme "Heavy Financial Burden". CM Yadav to interact with youth today: 20,000 to attend CM Youth Conclave at Lal Parade Ground. Landowners Can Seek Higher Compensation If Award Was Not Communicated, Indore High Court Rules. The Indore bench of Madhya Pradesh High Court has ruled that the limitation period for seeking enhanced land acquisition compensation begins from the date a landowner gains knowledge of an award if it was not communicated earlier. India-born cheetah gives birth to five cubs in Madhya Pradesh's Kuno National Park. Around 1,500 people to be recruited in Agriculture Department this year: Madhya Pradesh CM. Shahpura lake demarcation: NGT says agencies passing buck, wasting its time. Indore Trader Dies After Two-Wheeler Crashes Into Metro Divider, Family Alleges Negligence. Indore hair cosmetics trader Kamal Waghela died after his two-wheeler crashed into a metro project divider late Sunday night.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. EPS pension eligibility: Is EPS membership mandatory for you if your wages are rupees 25,000+? Check status. The government has raised the wage limit for the Employees' Provident Fund from rupees 15,000 to rupees 25,000 monthly. This adjustment mandates that employees earning under rupees 25,000 join the EPF and EPS schemes. Existing EPS members above this wage threshold will maintain their status, while new entrants won't be obliged to enroll. This reform seeks to enhance social security benefits for workers and their families. Tax department rejected rupees 37.82 lakh deduction, but ITAT cancelled the 200 percent penalty: What the ruling means. A Bangalore ITAT ruling has deleted a rupees 23.31 lakh penalty imposed on a cooperative housing society that claimed a rupees 37.82 lakh deduction under section 80P. The tribunal said a fully disclosed, bona fide claim on a debatable tax issue does not amount to misreporting. FD interest rate hike coming? With rising inflation, many experts expect RBI to hike interest rate. Many financial analysts expect the Reserve Bank of India to increase the repo rate by 25 basis points. This forecast is driven by persistent inflation, soaring crude oil prices, and a depreciating rupee. Should the RBI implement this hike, it could lead to higher fixed deposit returns for investors. Meanwhile, public sector banks continue to offer lower rates, struggling against fierce competition from government securities and small savings schemes. Starting your first job at 21? Here's how to start building your credit score without taking unnecessary financial risk. Starting a credit journey at 21 does not mean taking on unnecessary debt. A secured or entry-level credit card, disciplined spending, timely full repayments and controlled credit utilisation can help young borrowers build a strong credit history.
